reasoning: The person opens with an explicit brainstorm and names four possibilities, then closes by picking one to do now and saying the rest are only to be held in mind. The closing clause turns the auto-open-the-board-after-push possibility into a request for it now, so that idea and its selection are one act, an instruction, exactly as an answer to an open question completes the act already in play rather than adding a second. The other three - the morning Telegram bot, the dark theme, the terminal-instead-of-HTML swap - stay ideas nobody is asking for now; the person's own word was to keep them in mind, so they are answered and let go, with no row and no second list, since recording is not free and the skill keeps no place to file them. Nothing was in flight, so nothing is corrected or halted: the turn accepts one new result with its own goal and decision sheet, which admits the ticket and takes it in hand in the same call. The accepted work changes the push flow itself and what happens at the moment of a push, so it touches operations and release/observation; nothing else in it changes, so nothing else is named, and it needs only someone to build it.
